سُدُوسٌ (Sh, S, M, K) and ↓ سَدُوُسٌ , (Sh, M, K,) As used to say the latter, (S,) A [garment of the kind called] طَيْلَسَان: (M:) or a طيلسان, (S, M, K,) or any garment, (Sh,) of the colour termed خُضْرَة [here app. meaning a dark, or an ashy, dust-colour]. (Sh, S, M, K.) ＝
-A2- And the former, (K,) or the latter, (M,) Smoke-black of fat; or lamp-black; syn. نِيلَنْجٌ. (M, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
